title: MD simulations for rational design of high-affinity HDAC4 inhibitors - Analysis of non-bonding interaction energies for building new compounds.
authors: Dewaker, Varun; Srivastava, Pratik Narain; Debnath, Utsab; Srivastava, Ajay Kumar; Prabhakar, Yenamandra S
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过MD模拟设计HDAC4小分子抑制剂，对象为蛋白-小分子互作，非蛋白质-DNA体系，且无AI或结合建模方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: This study investigates the contributions of non-bonding energy (NBE) to the efficacy of four HDAC4 co-crystallized inhibitors (HA3, 9F4, EBE, and TFG) through 100ns Molecular Dynamics (MD) simulations. These inhibitors contain hydroxamic acid (HA3, 9F4, EBE) or diol (TFG) as zinc-binding groups. In PDBs 2VQJ and 2VQM, the HDAC4 catalytic domain is in the 'open' conformation, while in PDBs 4CBT and 6FYZ, the same is in the 'closed' conformation. We identified HA3 as a weaker inhibitor because of the unfavorable NBE contributions from its carbonyl fragment (FR3) and hydroxamic fragment (FR1). To enhance NBE efficacy, we designed novel HA3 analogs (H01-H16) by introducing diverse fragments (-CF3, 2-hydroxyacetic acid, -NH-CH2-, 5-fluoro-2-phenyl pyrimidine, and chloroquinoline moieties). MD simulations revealed promising analogs (H02, H07, H08, H15) with strong NBEs and stable ligand-zinc retention (2.07-2.33 A). These analogs exhibited strong relative binding free energies within their catalytic sites, highlighting their potential as novel HDAC4 inhibitors. The current study provides medicinal chemists with insights into non-covalent interactions, identifies key fragments for optimization, and offers a rational design strategy for developing more effective HDAC4 inhibitors.
abstract_zh: 本研究通过100ns分子动力学（Molecular Dynamics, MD）模拟，探讨了非键合能（non-bonding energy, NBE）对四种HDAC4共结晶抑制剂（HA3、9F4、EBE和TFG）功效的贡献。这些抑制剂含有异羟肟酸（HA3、9F4、EBE）或二醇（TFG）作为锌结合基团。在PDB 2VQJ和2VQM中，HDAC4催化域呈“开放”构象，而在PDB 4CBT和6FYZ中，同一结构呈“闭合”构象。我们识别出HA3为较弱抑制剂，因其羰基片段（FR3）和异羟肟酸片段（FR1）的NBE贡献不利。为增强NBE功效，我们通过引入多种片段（-CF3、2-羟基乙酸、-NH-CH2-、5-氟-2-苯基嘧啶和氯喹啉部分）设计了新型HA3类似物（H01-H16）。MD模拟揭示了具有强NBE和稳定配体-锌保留（2.07-2.33 Å）的有前景类似物（H02、H07、H08、H15）。这些类似物在其催化位点内表现出强相对结合自由能，突显其作为新型HDAC4抑制剂的潜力。本研究为药物化学家提供了非共价相互作用的见解，识别了优化关键片段，并为开发更有效的HDAC4抑制剂提供了合理设计策略。
